Securities Act of 1933 (&#167;230.405 of this chapter) or Rule 12b-2 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (&#167;240.12b-2 of this chapter). Emerging growth company <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2026-10-27to2026-10-27" name="dei:EntityEmergingGrowthCompany" format="ixt-sec:boolballotbox" id="ixv-251">&#9746;</ix:nonNumeric></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">If an emerging growth company, indicate by check mark if the registrant has elected not to use the extended transition period for complying with any new or revised financial accounting standards provided pursuant to Section 13(a) of the Exchange Act. <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2026-10-27to2026-10-27" name="dei:EntityExTransitionPeriod" format="ixt-sec:boolballotbox" id="ixv-252">&#9744;</ix:nonNumeric></p><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;</p><table style="font-size:1px;width:100%"><tbody><tr><td style="BORDER-BOTTOM: 2px solid;"/></tr><tr><td style="BORDER-BOTTOM: 5px solid;"/></tr></tbody></table><table style="border-spacing:0;font:10pt times new roman;width:100%" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr style="height:15px"><td class="hpbhr">&#160;</td></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td style="TEXT-INDENT: 0px;"/></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td><p style="page-break-after: always"></p></td></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td>&#160;</td></tr></tbody></table><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;"><strong>Item 1.02 Termination of a Material Definitive Agreement.</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">On February 5, 2026, Ecominas Corp. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement (the &#8220;Original Agreement&#8221;) with Francisco Antonio Sbert Mousko (the &#8220;Seller&#8221;), which the parties amended by a First Amendment dated July 24, 2026 (the &#8220;Amendment&#8221; and, together with the Original Agreement, the &#8220;APA&#8221;). As amended, the APA provided for the Company to acquire certain technology and intellectual-property assets and certain operational-use real-property and land-use interests (the &#8220;Purchased Assets&#8221;) in exchange for 700,000 shares of the Company&#8217;s Series A Preferred Stock (the &#8220;Consideration Shares&#8221;). The Original Agreement was filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the Company&#8217;s Registration Statement on Form 10, and the Amendment was filed as Exhibit 10.4 to the Company&#8217;s Registration Statement on Form S-1/A.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">As previously disclosed, the transaction under the APA closed on July 24, 2026. At closing, the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors approved the issuance of the Consideration Shares, and the Company delivered a treasury order instructing its transfer agent to issue the Consideration Shares to the Seller. The Company&#8217;s prior reports described the Consideration Shares as issued; however, the transfer agent had not issued the Consideration Shares. Following closing, the Seller did not deliver the Purchased Assets to the Company.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">On October 28, 2026, the Company delivered to the Seller written notice terminating and rescinding the APA, effective immediately, on the basis of the Seller&#8217;s breach and repudiation of the APA. As a result of the Seller&#8217;s breach and repudiation, the Company withdrew its treasury order and instructed its transfer agent not to issue the Consideration Shares, and, on October 28, 2026, the Company relinquished any interest in the Purchased Assets by way of letter to Seller. No Consideration Shares were issued, and none will be issued. The Company did not incur any early termination penalties in connection with the termination.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;"><strong>Item 8.01 Other Events.</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">On October 27, 2026, the Board of Directors of Ecominas Corp. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) approved a proposed amendment to the Company's Articles of Incorporation to change its corporate name from &#8220;Ecominas Corp.&#8221; to &#8220;EcoCora Intelligence Corp.,&#8221; subject to the requisite shareholder approval.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px 0px 0px 0in; text-align:justify;">The proposed name change has not yet become effective and remains subject to applicable corporate and regulatory requirements, including the filing of an amendment to the Company's Articles of Incorporation with the Nevada Secretary of State and processing of the applicable corporate action by the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (&#8220;FINRA&#8221;).<strong> </strong></p><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;</p><table style="border-spacing:0;font:10pt times new roman;width:100%" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr style="height:15px"><td class="hpbhr">&#160;</td></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td style="BORDER-BOTTOM: black 1px solid; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrant has duly caused this report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned hereunto duly authorized.</p><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;</p><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px 0px 0px 0in"><strong>ECOMINAS CORP.</strong></p><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;</p><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">Date: October 28, 2026</p><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;</p><table style="border-spacing:0;font-size:10pt;text-align:left;width:100%" cellpadding="0"><tbody><tr style="height:15px"><td style="width:5%;"><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">By: </p></td><td style="BORDER-BOTTOM: #000000 1px solid;width:35%;"><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px"><em>/s/ Franklin Mar&#237;n Toro </em></p></td><td><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;</p></td></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">Name: </p></td><td><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">Franklin Mar&#237;n Toro</p></td><td><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;</p></td></tr><tr style="height:15px"><td><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">Title: </p></td><td><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">Chief Executive Officer</p></td><td><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;</p></td></tr></tbody></table><p style="font-size:10pt;font-family:times new roman;margin:0px">&#160;
